evidence.P1: Reluctant One ev-014/032/038/044 depend on outside-chain events ev-010/013, ev-031, ev-037, ev-041/043 for causation, violating same-plot necessity
evidence.P2: Each plot maintains one dilemma lens (Reluctant One identity, Rescue sacrifice, Awakening truth vs lie, Betrayer meaning vs pleasure, Hunter freedom vs determinism) without internal retelling
evidence.P3: Rescue omits ev-033 assault; Awakening omits ev-005 comfortable-life anchor; Hunter omits ev-010/032 choice beats; Reluctant One pads ev-020 Cypher caution and Betrayer pads ev-025/026 sacrifice
evidence.P4: Four plots close cleanly (Reluctant One ev-045 embodiment, Rescue ev-035 belief, Awakening ev-013 recoil, Betrayer ev-029 death) but Hunter compresses ev-014->ev-045 in 4 beats leaving middle turns thin
evidence.P5: Hunter chain ev-014,023,039,045 is fully contained within Reluctant One same four events, rehashing prophecy-to-destruction under near-identical fate/identity theme; Rescue/Betrayer also duplicate ev-025/026

raw.commentary: Layer is thematically disciplined and mostly arc-complete, but causal integrity and membership suffer from Reluctant One's external dependencies and padding/missing beats, and Hunter is a redundant subset of Reluctant One, driving P1, P3, P5 low despite strong Rescue/Awakening/Betrayer chains.
